findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 10 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 25 questions numbered 1-25; by section: 10.2 2, 10.3 1, 10.4 1, 10.5 1, 10.6 1, 10.8 1, 10.9 3, 10.10 2, 10.11 1, 10.14 1, 10.15 1, 10.16 2, 10.17 2, 10.18 1, 10.19 2, 10.20 1, 10.22 1, 10.27 1.

Theory questions on redox and agents, oxidation number rules, disproportionation, balancing by the oxidation number method, the electrolytic cell, Faraday and mass deposited, the charge on 1 mole of electrons, electrode potential and the double layer, measuring E°, the Ag-Zn cell, electrolytic vs galvanic cells, applications of E°, concentration effects (Table 10.1), the activity series, photovoltaic cells, BOD/DO and the Winkler method; numericals on oxidation numbers, electrolysis (mass, time, current), Avogadro's constant, E°cell, feasibility and the Nernst equation with new values recomputed in Python. Exercise questions (Zn-Cu cell construction, SHE, Nernst variation, Avogadro derivation) are not repeated. Book corrections followed (Zn²⁺ + 2e⁻, 2H₂O, twice on the left, Cl₂(g), 99646 C, E°(cathode) − E°(anode), Ag⁺/Ag +0.80 V, Mg²⁺/Mg −2.37 V, KMnO₄ +1.51 V).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
